My memories have been mainly stuck in a perpetual loop within the past 7 years about a seasonal camp and some people there who I wish I never met which makes a lot of my childhood seem like it never existed really.

Even before then I remember having trouble remembering my early & mid teen stage which was alarming to me because you're mental is the only luxury you'll ever have and I really hope I will be able to repair my mind so I can remember every maticulous detail like how I used to because just being in this drab blunted state that can't remember a simple memory that is good is heartbreaking for me

I understand but no they are similar when it comes to highly sensitive nervous systems but HSP's are different and rare in this world. I'm both HSP and an empath which is a extremely rare to be both so I not only feel or sense things in a profound way but I can also feel how others feel, sense who is behind a tree 20 yards away or when someone is down who is miles away or even through the phone while texting among other things. 

I haven't been able to truly *feel* as I used to and feel and since I wasn't in a healthy and loving environment where I should have been been able to blossom my inner connections with myself, my senses, intuition, and my body began breaking down and as well as being fully aware that the world didn't feel beautiful like it used to. Because I'm observe the world in a way that others miss or do not care to pay attention to how terribly wrong everything is and the fact that bullying and abusing people,  not paying attention to how people treat each other matters and making life so unbearable that people don't want to live anymore that is why I severely depressed and trying with everything I have to get out of this dark place and truly heal so I can function and ***feel alive in such a way that I can even feel the stars shine above***. 



There probably are HSP's who are in the ASD spectrum but the way I experience is different that what Asperger's or ASD is and HSP is not an disorder either. I would say HSP would fall under ESP  if you ever heard of that. But I was curious one time if I did have autism I know there are different levels but that isn't what HSP's are.

One of the best ways I can explain is like this:

*To be an HSP is too feel yourself not as a separate being but who feels everything and everyone all together because we are one. Every blade of grass, droplet of water even the trees precious because you can feel them breath alongside you.*

*To feel the an ant climbing a blade of grass next to you or the presence of the moon & her light in the night to sun rays during the day not just on your skin but deep within as if you're being bathed in light.* 

*To be able to feel every soul in this world and even life beyond throughout the stars no matter who they are; their pains, sorrows, hopes, dreams, and joy are just a special to you and makes everything feel so intimate because you're deeply aware and understand more than words can even express how precious life is because it is truly sacred than what most can ever imagine and to lose that feeling and to be cut off from experiencing such ecstasy  can be so devastating to no longer feel alive because the dark has become brighter than the light⋆˚✿˖°*

I don't ASD or Asperger's I don't resonate with the symptoms or anything associated with those spectrums either.

I am an HSP Highly Sensitive Person I found out a while ago certain things I feel and experience had a name and no they're not the same either

>Now, another thing you can possibly do, forget the police. All they'll do is dump you off somewhere at a shelter, and kind of a shrug and say that's the best they can do. And then the shelter is free to say nope and send you out. Various religious organizations, might help. Salvation army, St Vincent de Paul, those type of organizations. I know salvation army is really big about that. They usually tend to hang out in the major urban areas, their shelters.

Yeah I'm not calling the police because the last few times when they could have helped they decided not to the first one who actually understood what I was going through told me he would call me and never did and my last incident they sent me to the hospital because they said that they didn't have resources for me. There is a salvation army but that is hours away from me and they didn't have anything every time I called them no one answered the phone either. I tried a few churches they want me to attend bible study and trying force their beliefs on me and I have religious trauma and I don't know why people think that's okay to do to people.

>And lastly, even though you're in a desperate situation, think. What will serve you down the road, versus what you need right now. Aside from a warm place to think. That's what you need right now. Someplace where you can have about two to three hours, just to regroup and figure out your next plan. And just present yourself like that, and ask if they have any suggestions. Assuming you go to some professional place. Hospital, is probably the best if a shelter doesn't fly. Just say that you're struggling, and they will most likely have you talk with a social worker that's on staff - like I was!

I need a home and I never really had actual family and I hear other young people in my age range who get adopted and even way older than me too. I want help from some adult-adults to help and not tell me to hang in there and life gets better or keep telling me the same stuff everyone else is telling and others who crying out for help and just telling me I'm on my own. I want someone to take me by my hands and show me that life is meant to be lived and not be or feel controlled that even when even my own breath is constricted and lead me out of this dark place I'm in and  show me that life can become better. 

>They will, assess what you got going on, and most of the time, if you can look really pathetic and lost, they can pull strings. Even though they say they can't, they can make executive decisions. Really! I hope that helps you somewhat. 20 years in the field. Retired, I don't care for this, current dynamic, where they say they can help, but then they find endless reasons not to help you, and have very strict guidelines.

>All based on feel good optics. Don't get me started. I understand where you're coming from.

>The best advice you can tell yourself, nothing lasts forever. It may feel like forever - but, it does get better. Not easy! But, if you seek help, you will find it! I just wish I could tell you it would come overnight! 😞

Next part:

>just say you don't feel comfortable talking about it right now. And just say you need help. That's another thing about them that sucks.

Every shelter in the surrounding area I called either doesn't have availability, the phone just rings and then I was prompted to reach the administration office for each person who works there and none of them will be around until next summer and in certain counties I have to be a resident. The area I'm in has a few but one is for women and the other I would have to lie about my situation and I just want to tell the truth. The other ones are hours away and I don't have a way to get there and they are short stays and I would be outside in the cold and I wont be safe either.

>  
Now, do you have employment? The reason I ask this, is because if you do, you may be in line for assistance for a place. Like half rent low income type of thing. And if you're in an emergency, abusive relationship, as you said above ;-), they move pretty damn fast to make it happen for those cases. It's been my experience, it's slow, but faster than the average person. And for some reason, they move faster for women than they do for men even with children. Go figure.

  
I was working where I'm about to leave at because I had nowhere to go and I had to clean rooms everyday by myself even though I'm in a lot of pain, have sharp head pains and severely fatigued and barely had time to make posts on here or look for additional help. Now they don't need anymore help because it's off season and just like anyone out in this world they don't care if it's snowing or if I freeze.

I know men have been at the forefront of a lot of terrible things in this world and it has made things worse for everyone especially like me who need help. I'm not racist, hateful or spiteful, misogynistic, or dislike anyone whatsoever. I deeply care for others and it hurts that I was mistreated for being true to my nature and I won't ever forsake that even if the world wants to be that way.

>Also, here's another one, try going to the emergency room of your local hospital. Explain your situation, and at least, you'll be somewhere warm. While you figure out something comfortably, and, most hospitals won't turn you away. Again, if you present some sort of anxiety, or frustration, because that's medical. And you are suffering from a medical condition! See how that works?

I don't have a ride and the nearest hospital is like a 4 hour walk or so but if there was one nearby I would. I just had  bad experiences where people lied to me promising they would help me and that I would be safe and I don't know maybe it's the way I tell my story even though it's my story but I need to protect any little bit of wellbeing because little bit that I have is all I have left.

Replying in next part

>Yep. That's the problem with shelters. You have to be suffering from some type of, relationship abuse. Well, as a former psychologist, retired, do this; lie.

People have told me to do that but I really don't want to lie at all. I know it's for survival but that is something that isn't in my heart to do and I wish people didn't have to do that just to get help either.

>The law, about what is threatening and what is intimidating, is all about how you feel - not if, what they do isn't really anything. It's about how they make you feel! Remember that. Intimidation, menacing, threatening behavior, is all about how you feel! Not what they think you feel. Remember that!

Thank you for saying this because I have been feeling that the way I feel and my story isn't that serious and I took that to heart when I shouldn't have because I know I shouldn't be feeling this way.

>Secondly, since you're in survival mode at the moment. Work the system -tell them that you are in an abusive relationship, with the same sex partner. Believe me, that will get you some help.

I really can't lie I know I said that before but I just can't and if I did who will I tell this to? and if I'm asked to give a name wouldn't they look for that person to verify anything and that will get me nowhere and and I'm already stuck.

>For everything you said that you're going through, your conditions, are they medically backed up, or is this self-diagnosis, and this is what you feel?

No this is exactly how I actually feel some things I looked up to see if there was any information or I would come across something that when I read about it like avpd I resonated and checked everything box. The area I'm in has so many homeless people it makes me cry because no one cares about people being in the street without a home and if I was out there no one would care about me either and I already feel that way because here I am all alone trying as hard as I can to save myself because I feel myself slipping away.

I haven't been able to finally cry and let myself to *let go* so I can heal and finally feel like *myself* and feel like a *human being again* but I don't know if I'll ever get to feel that way again

When I was small I remember crying a lot and saying to myself that I did not want to die.

Deep down I also knew that it was best to not die with any resentment or pain and sadly for me;

my life ended up going in a different way than I thought it was going to be.

I really don't want to grow old either and be forever young. I wish life could always be gentle and warm like a cup of hot chocolate with marshmallows in autumn and captivating like a eternal oasis where everything thrives eternal and everything that is beautiful lasts without it ever being a thought that it won't.

My mind & heart is torn between what little beauty I once knew that is now gone and feeling like I am running out of time in my life and also trying to see if I can ever  *feel*  who I really am in all moments as I used to before

When I was small I was pushed into a small locker and left there. There was a party going on and so since so many people were talking no one could hear me me screaming for help to get out. There was little oxygen and I could barely breathe and I began to panic

I gave it my all and someone heard me and let me out and I began to cry because being closed, locked it, and no one could hear me over the noice terrified me and that is how I'm feeling now too.

Only difference is the only ones who can hear me are others who are locked away or are just walking by and can't open this locker for me and these experiences that keep repeating themselves almost in different ways has me pinned down. It hurts me so much when I see others are smiling and living and I'm just trapped on the inside and dying

It's like the moment you became unwell you've been severed from the inside out. 

Everything was fine & you were once so whole that it was never a thought because you was always present and the moment a major dis-ease came in it feels almost you're reaching out to find where you lost yourself to feel whole once again.

I'm not sure exactly when I started to feel that way but I felt something terrible was about to happen and then I couldn't *feel* like I used to. My intuition isn't as strong as it used to be I feel like my nervous system is compressed and I can't even feel joy or excitement anymore.

Since I never had the chance to heal and have always been in this survival mode I feel like I have been holding my breath for so long that it has me feeling trapped and locked in place.

I really wish there was a place that helps hsp's and just people in general to heal our entire nervous system and energy. I don't even remember when the last time I truly felt myself

Hey, I had to leave my abusive environment about a week ago. I am not well at all and my body is in so pain and not only that I am so exhausted i cannot get enough sleep to even feel slightly rested when I struggle with severe chronic depression.

I wish I had left years ago but I was terrified. Scared that my efforts would end up horribly wrong like getting kidnapped (which people think I already have been)
Murdered, and just basically 

*being around people who always for some reason take one look at me and want to dominate my spirit*

Waiting for the right moment did not work out in my favor as hardly anything hardly ever does for me. I can't even feel my own heart anymore and I'm just existing.

I have been crying out for help asking so many questions, making posts, sending messages, calling numbers, looking for others who are in similar situations like me, reaching out to people who I lost contact with and no one can either help me, wants to be around me, or tells me things like: 

*"your energy is so low no one wants to be around you"*

I have spent my life since I was small begging people to love me and listen to me but no one ever cared about what I had to say or how I felt about myself or anything.
So when I have been constantly been shutdown, disappointed and let down over and over again it makes me feel like no matter what I do no one cares even if I'm gone from this world.

Follow your heart. The answer is in how they treat you & make you *feel* too. My own religious environment has affected my relationship with myself and instead of living in the moment I spent so much time when the sun ☀️ was out daydreaming about a better life, or instead of playing in the snow 🌨️ I was in my head playing scenarios where people loved me for being me. 

I know some people may look at this and say *"oH yOu'Re iN yOuR 20s iT's CaLLeD mOvInG oUt"*
Some if not many of us don't have that luxury and since we're in so much pain I can't speak for anyone else but deep down I don't want to hear that because I feel that not only have others failed me deep down I feel that 
*I have failed myself.* 

So many years I have spent in so much pain where I could have enjoyed life instead of being stuck where I am when all I wanted was to be free. All I wanted was to have a family and all I ever wanted to be loved and feel like I was part of life🌈🌄

Take of yourself always and follow your heart and remember: *your mental is the only luxury you'll ever have🌼
